name: MES initial-balance sequential-target ladder

targets: directional overnight extreme when beyond entry
rules.baseline: first stop-entry IB break; opposite-IB stop; otherwise RTH close

historical_mes_campaign_lower_bound.basis: sum of wfo_config grid-combo counts over DISTINCT (content-hashed) verdict artifacts
historical_mes_campaign_lower_bound.caveat: lower bound: unlogged experiments are uncountable and can only increase deflation

trial_accounting.caveat: Measured lower bound, not unknowable exact truth: unlogged experiments can only make DSR stricter. Historical helper content-dedupes artifacts; current family count is entry(2)xstop(2)xtarget(4).

is_selection.selection_rule: maximum IS observed-frequency Sharpe, then expectancy, then PF; OOS unseen

resolution_sensitivity_15m.warning: 15-minute bars are lower-resolution and used only as terminal-window/resolution sensitivity evidence

limitations: Primary cache is a stitched, non-back-adjusted continuous MES series; roll transitions can affect overnight references near contract switches.
Five-minute bars do not reveal intrabar path; same-bar collisions resolve stop-first and dual-IB breaks are excluded.
Campaign trial count 226 is a measured lower bound because unlogged experiments cannot be reconstructed.
